Contact sheet

Click a frame to leave it out of the sheet. Click again to put it back. The palette comes from the whole clip.

Palette

click to copy

Motion

Height shows how much of the picture changes. Dots mark beats, the moments of biggest change. Ticks underneath show where the sheet frames come from.

In-between frames

Each row is one beat, captured from start to finish. It shows the AI how a change unfolds, not just where it ends up.

Check the AI's result

After the AI gives you code, preview it in Reel Canvas and export it as a video. Drop that video here. The Lab compares timing, colour and motion with the reference and writes a fix list for the AI.

Measure

          
The drag test sends real pointer events along the timeline for 4 seconds with each method. The playback test plays 6 seconds and counts frames.

          

          

          
MethodPictureExactOff byFrames/sSkipped

          
PlaybackFrames shownStart-upStallsBehind clockPicture vs audio

          
Picture is the time from your drag to something on screen. Exact is when the true frame arrived. Off by is how far the shown frame was from the one you asked for. Lower is better. Medians, with the slowest 5% after a slash.
